$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: Before you move your salary
templates.body: Some pricing and fee waivers depend on your salary being paid into this bank. Moving it can change instalments on salary-linked finance and end those waivers. You can see what is linked to your salary in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل نقل راتبك
templates.body: بعض الأسعار والإعفاءات من الرسوم مرتبطة بتحويل راتبك إلى هذا البنك. نقله قد يغيّر أقساط التمويل المرتبط بالراتب وينهي تلك الإعفاءات. يمكنك الاطلاع على ما يرتبط براتبك في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.
